nom: Vichy LiftActiv Collagen Specialist 16 Day Cream

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin are split: some find the cream too thick or heavy for daytime wear, while one specifically praises it for cutting shine on oily skin and another with oily-prone skin found it too rich for her face but well suited to her neck.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin generally report no extra oiliness or irritation, with one recommending it specifically for combination skin.
segments.dry: One reviewer describes her normally dry skin feeling velvety and not greasy after just one use; another with dry skin found it not quite moisturizing enough on its own and layers a separate moisturizer on top.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are divided: several report no irritation, redness, or stinging and say the cream actually calmed their skin, while others had reactions ranging from itchiness serious enough to stop use to a case of sustained redness, inflammation, and breakouts.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s and 50s, and others describing themselves as part of an 'older generation,' report firmer, smoother, more youthful-looking skin, recommending it for aging concerns.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers, including several in their 40s and 50s, report visibly smoother, firmer skin with softened fine lines and wrinkles within one to a few weeks of consistent use; a few say they saw no meaningful anti-aging improvement even after a month.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers describe the cream as deeply hydrating and plumping without heaviness or greasiness; a few say it didn't provide enough moisture for their needs, and one reviewer felt it actually dried her skin out.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers, including some with sensitive skin, report no redness or irritation; one reviewer's skin stayed red, inflamed, and broke out over several weeks of testing, and she had to discontinue use.
concerns.spots: Two reviewers report fewer visible dark spots or areas of discoloration after using the cream for a few weeks.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report no breakouts or irritation, including one with acne-prone skin who simply reduced frequency because the cream felt heavier than her usual routine; one reviewer's skin broke out and became inflamed over several weeks of use and she discontinued it.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers say the cream can feel too rich or heavy for daytime wear on oily areas, though one specifically credits it with cutting shine and another says it doesn't add oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Can cause makeup to pill for some
Rich, velvety texture that absorbs well
Considered pricey for the amount of product

extraits.texte: I was so excited to be able to try the Vichy collagen day cream that I got free for my honest opinion. Unfortunately, I was only able to try it one time. The only and only time I tried it, and I did not use a lot of product, my face became very itchy. I washed my face immediately and am very thankful that's all that happened. I did not try again. I hope this day cream works for someone!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]. Something about this system did not agree with my skin. I tested for several weeks hoping my skin would purge and get used to it but my skin stayed red, inflamed, and broken out. Had to discontinue use. I'm sure this is a great product for someone with different skin than me. I thought the packaging looked high-end.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This day cream was just ok for me. I need hydration the most and I felt like this did not give enough. I also do not like the smell, but it was short lived. Overall it was light and I had no issues with breakouts/irritation. I do think this would be good for someone who has more standard/oily skin.
